summary: Serve tiny current-client summary counts on the existing collection protocol

replay.detail: Existing graph admission, projection and recovery behavior is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or projection version changes. Native summary reads existing projections and caches.

rules.detail: Existing graph admission, projection and recovery behavior is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Add optional summary capability version 1 and one summary/current resource on the existing WebSocket collection protocol. Generated Rust, TypeScript and Swift models accept the new kind. Core lists, filters and get routes retain their behavior; older clients preserve unknown kinds.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon binary replacement is needed to advertise summary; no source backfill or IVM activation is required.

manual.detail: Clients use the summary capability and retain compatibility behavior on older daemons.

recovery.detail: Existing graph admission, projection and recovery behavior is unchanged.
